description: #803: net.connect takes Node 22's socket options: with allowHalfOpen the client stays writable after its peer's FIN and sends no FIN of its own, so a client-only program exits after 'end' with nothing to write; an end(data) 20 ms after 'end' keeps the program alive until all of it is written ('end' callback, then 'finish'); ref() after EOF doesn't hold the loop again, with or without a pending end(data); unref() before EOF with a timer still delivers a post-EOF end(data) in full; and the timeout option is socket.setTimeout
